facts.function: electronic engine speed/load controllers and an integrated valve actuator

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8537 covers apparatus for electric control incl. programmable controllers for voltage not exceeding 1,000 V

rejected_alternatives.reason: K89109 put an analog governor with no software there; the APECS digital controllers are programmable (N273606-type), so 8537 is preferred
valve heading for the actuator-valve assembly; the controllers are the predominant named goods
DC motor line for a separate actuator; the actuator is integrated here

missing_facts: Whether the integrated valve actuator should be classified separately (classify separately: integrated valve actuator, likely 8501/8412/8481)
Whether the controller is digital programmable (assumed from the word digital)
classification.rationale: The description names three engine control articles, two of them digital controllers. CBP ruling N273606 classed a Woodward engine control module with software under 8537.10.9060 (programmable controllers). K89109 classed an analog, software-free governor in 9032.89.60, which differs by construction. The first-named valve actuator could fall elsewhere.
